1987 Fijian coups d'état.headline: Državna udara na Fidžiju leta 1987
paragraphs: Državna udara na Fidžiju leta 1987 sta strmoglavila nedavno izvoljeno vlado premierja Timocija Bavadre, Elizabeto II. odstavila s položaja fidžijske kraljice in privedla do razglasitve republike. Prvi udar, s katerim so odstavili Bavadro, je bil 14. maja 1987. Drugi je 25. septembra odpravil monarhijo, kmalu zatem, 10. oktobra, pa so razglasili republiko. Obe vojaški akciji je vodil podpolkovnik Sitiveni Rabuka, tedaj tretji v poveljniški verigi Kraljevih fidžijskih oboroženih sil.

source.title: 1987 Fijian coups d'état
paragraphs: The Fijian coups d'état of 1987 resulted in the overthrow of the recently elected government of Fijian Prime Minister Timoci Bavadra, the deposition of Elizabeth II as Queen of Fiji, and in the declaration of a republic. The first coup d'état, in which Bavadra was deposed, took place on 14 May 1987; a second coup d'état on 25 September ended the monarchy, and was shortly followed by the proclamation of a republic on 10 October. Both military actions were led by Lieutenant Colonel Sitiveni Rabuka, then third in command of the Royal Fiji Military Forces.

2006 Fijian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar na Fidžiju leta 2006
paragraphs: Državni udar na Fidžiju decembra 2006 je izvedel komodor Frank Bainimarama proti premierju Laiseniji Qaraseju in predsedniku Josefi Iloilu. Bil je vrhunec politične krize, ki se je začela leto prej, ko je Qaraseova vlada fidžijskemu parlamentu predložila tri predloge zakonov. Zakoni Qoliqoli, o zemljiškem sodišču ter o spravi, strpnosti in enotnosti so zadevali etnične spore na Fidžiju in posledice državnega udara leta 2000, veljali pa so za naklonjene etničnim Fidžijcem. Bainimarama, poveljnik Oboroženih sil Republike Fidži (RFMF), je 16. oktobra vladi predal seznam zahtev, med katerimi je bil tudi umik zakonov. Poskusi pogajanj so propadli, 4. decembra pa je vojska izvedla udar. Razpustili so parlament, razrešili Qaraseja in njegovo vlado ter nekaj civilnih uradnikov postavili v hišni pripor. Ko Veliki svet poglavarjev ni hotel imenovati vojski naklonjene vlade, se je Bainimarama dogovoril z Iloilom in ga 4. januarja 2007 vrnil na predsedniški položaj. Iloilo je nato Bainimaramo imenoval za vršilca dolžnosti premierja in vodjo začasne vlade.

source.title: 2006 Fijian coup d'état
paragraphs: The Fijian coup d'état of December 2006 was a coup d'état in Fiji carried out by Commodore Frank Bainimarama against Prime Minister Laisenia Qarase and President Josefa Iloilo. It was the culmination of a political crisis that had begun the previous year when the Qarase government introduced three bills to the Fijian Parliament. The Qoliqoli, Land Tribunal, and Reconciliation, Tolerance, and Unity Bills dealt with the ongoing ethnic conflicts in Fiji and the aftermath of the 2000 coup, and were considered to be pro-ethnic Fijian. Bainimarama, the Commander of the Republic of Fiji Military Forces (RFMF), presented the government with a list of demands on 16 October that included withdrawing the bills. Attempts at negotiation failed and the military launched a coup on 4 December. Parliament was dissolved, Qarase and his cabinet were dismissed, and some civilian officials were placed under house arrest. After the Great Council of Chiefs refused to appoint a cabinet friendly to the military, Bainimarama reached an understanding with Iloilo and reinstated him as president on 4 January 2007. Iloilo then appointed Bainimarama acting prime minister in charge of the Interim Cabinet.

Actions along the Matanikau.headline: Spopada ob reki Matanikau
paragraphs: Spopada ob reki Matanikau, včasih imenovana druga in tretja bitka ob Matanikauju, sta bila dva ločena, a povezana spopada ameriških in japonskih cesarskih pomorskih in kopenskih sil na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Potekala sta okoli reke Matanikau na otoku Guadalcanal v jugozahodnem Pacifiku, med guadalcanalsko kampanjo. Prvi je trajal od 23. do 27. septembra, drugi od 6. do 9. oktobra; bila sta dva izmed največjih in najpomembnejših spopadov ob tej reki.
notes: The source gives no year for the two engagements; none is added (they were in 1942).

source.title: Actions along the Matanikau
paragraphs: The Actions along the Matanikau—sometimes referred to as the Second and Third Battles of the Matanikau—were two separate but related engagements between the United States and Imperial Japanese naval and ground forces in the Pacific theater of World War II. The actions occurred around the Matanikau River on Guadalcanal Island in the southwestern Pacific during the Guadalcanal campaign. These particular engagements—the first taking place between 23 and 27 September, and the second between 6 and 9 October—were two of the largest and most significant of the Matanikau actions.

Battle for Henderson Field.headline: Bitka za Hendersonovo letališče
paragraphs: Bitka za Hendersonovo letališče, ki so jo Japonci imenovali bitka za Guadalcanal ali bitka pri rtu Lunga, je potekala od 23. do 26. oktobra 1942 na Guadalcanalu na Salomonovih otokih in v njegovi okolici. V tej bitki na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne so se na kopnem, na morju in v zraku spopadle japonska cesarska kopenska vojska in mornarica ter zavezniške sile, predvsem ameriški marinci in kopenska vojska. Bila je zadnja od treh velikih japonskih kopenskih ofenziv v guadalcanalski kampanji.
Ameriški marinci in kopenska vojska so v njej odbili napad japonske 17. armade pod poveljstvom generalpodpolkovnika Harukičija Hjakutakeja.
notes: Japanese names transcribed by the Slovenian rules: Harukichi Hyakutake → Harukiči Hjakutake.

source.title: Battle for Henderson Field
paragraphs: The Battle for Henderson Field, also known as the Battle of Guadalcanal or Battle of Lunga Point by the Japanese, took place from 23 to 26 October 1942 on and around Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands. The battle was a land, sea, and air battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II and was fought between the Imperial Japanese Army and Navy and Allied forces, mainly U.S. Marines and Army. The battle was the last of three major land offensives conducted by the Japanese during the Guadalcanal campaign.
In the battle, U.S. Marine and Army forces repulsed an attack by the Japanese 17th Army under the command of Lieutenant General Harukichi Hyakutake.

Battle of Arawe.headline: Bitka pri Araweju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Araweju, znana tudi kot operacija Director, je bila spopad zavezniških in japonskih sil v kampanji na Novi Britaniji med drugo svetovno vojno. Bila je del zavezniške operacije Kolo (Cartwheel) in je odvračala pozornost pred večjim izkrcanjem pri rtu Gloucester konec decembra 1943. Japonska vojska je zavezniško ofenzivo na zahodu Nove Britanije pričakovala in je območje ravno krepila, ko so se zavezniki 15. decembra 1943 izkrcali pri Araweju. Po približno mesecu občasnih bojev s številčno šibkejšimi Japonci so zavezniki Arawe zavarovali.
notes: Operation Cartwheel follows the glossary (operacija Kolo) with the code name in brackets; Slovenian usage often keeps code names untranslated, so the glossary entry is worth a review.

source.title: Battle of Arawe
paragraphs: The Battle of Arawe (also known as Operation Director) was fought between Allied and Japanese forces during the New Britain campaign of World War II. The battle formed part of the Allied Operation Cartwheel and was a diversion before a larger landing at Cape Gloucester in late December 1943. The Japanese military was expecting an Allied offensive in western New Britain and was reinforcing the region at the time of the Allied landing in the Arawe area on 15 December 1943. The Allies secured Arawe after about a month of intermittent fighting with the outnumbered Japanese force.

Battle of Blackett Strait.headline: Bitka v Blackettovi ožini
paragraphs: Bitka v Blackettovi ožini (japonsko: ビラ・スタンモーア夜戦, bitka Vila–Stanmore) je bila pomorska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekala 6. marca 1943 v Blackettovi ožini med Kolombangaro in otokom Arundel na Salomonovih otokih. Naključno sta se srečala dva japonska rušilca, ki sta dostavljala zaloge v Vilo, in ameriška pomorska skupina s tremi lahkimi križarkami in tremi rušilci, ki je imela nalogo obstreljevati japonske obalne objekte okoli Vile. Sili sta se spopadli, ko sta se japonska rušilca umikala skozi zaliv Kula. V kratki bitki so ameriške ladje potopile oba japonska rušilca, nato pa dokončale obstreljevanje Vile in se vrnile v oporišče.

source.title: Battle of Blackett Strait
paragraphs: The Battle of Blackett Strait (Japanese: ビラ・スタンモーア夜戦 (Battle of Vila–Stanmore)) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought on 6 March 1943 in the Blackett Strait, between Kolombangara and Arundel Island in the Solomon Islands. The battle was a chance encounter between two Japanese destroyers that had been undertaking a resupply run to Vila and a U.S. Navy force of three light cruisers and three destroyers that had been tasked with bombarding the Japanese shore facilities around Vila. The two forces clashed as the Japanese destroyers were withdrawing through the Kula Gulf. In the short battle that followed the two Japanese destroyers were sunk, after which the U.S. ships completed their bombardment of Vila before returning to their base.

Battle of Buna–Gona.headline: Bitka pri Buni in Goni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Buni in Goni je bila del kampanje na Novi Gvineji na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Sledila je koncu kampanje na poti Kokoda in je trajala od 16. novembra 1942 do 22. januarja 1943. Avstralske in ameriške sile so se bojevale proti japonskim mostiščem pri Buni, Sananandi in Goni, iz katerih so Japonci prej sprožili kopenski napad na Port Moresby. Zaradi razvoja dogodkov v kampanji na Salomonovih otokih so japonske enote, ki so se bližale Port Moresbyju, dobile ukaz, naj se umaknejo do teh oporišč na severni obali in jih zavarujejo. Avstralske enote so ostale v stiku s sovražnikom, ki se je umikal v urejenih zaščitnih bojih. Cilj zaveznikov je bil pregnati Japonce s teh položajev in jim preprečiti, da bi jih še uporabljali. Japonske sile so se branile spretno, pripravljeno in odločno ter so zgradile močno mrežo dobro skritih utrdb.

source.title: Battle of Buna–Gona
paragraphs: The battle of Buna–Gona was part of the New Guinea campaign in the Pacific theatre during World War II. It followed the conclusion of the Kokoda Track campaign and lasted from 16 November 1942 until 22 January 1943. The battle was fought by Australian and United States forces against the Japanese beachheads at Buna, Sanananda and Gona. From these, the Japanese had launched an overland attack on Port Moresby. In light of developments in the Solomon Islands campaign, Japanese forces approaching Port Moresby were ordered to withdraw to and secure these bases on the northern coast. Australian forces maintained contact as the Japanese conducted a well-ordered rearguard action. The Allied objective was to eject the Japanese forces from these positions and deny them their further use. The Japanese forces were skillful, well prepared and resolute in their defence. They had developed a strong network of well-concealed defences.

Battle of Cape Esperance.headline: Bitka pri rtu Esperance
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Esperance, znana tudi kot druga bitka pri otoku Savo, v japonskih virih pa kot pomorska bitka pri otoku Savo (サボ島沖海戦), je potekala 11. in 12. oktobra 1942 na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne med japonsko cesarsko mornarico in ameriško vojno mornarico. Bila je druga od štirih velikih bitk površinskih ladij v guadalcanalski kampanji in je potekala ob vhodu v ožino med otokom Savo in Guadalcanalom na Salomonovih otokih. Ime je dobila po rtu Esperance (9° 15′ j. g. š., 159° 42′ v. g. d.), najsevernejši točki Guadalcanala.

source.title: Battle of Cape Esperance
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Esperance, also known as the Second Battle of Savo Island and in Japanese sources as the Sea Battle of Savo Island (サボ島沖海戦), took place on 11–12 October 1942, in the Pacific campaign of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Navy and United States Navy. The naval battle was the second of four major surface engagements during the Guadalcanal campaign and took place at the entrance to the strait between Savo Island and Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands. Cape Esperance (9°15′S 159°42′E) is the northernmost point on Guadalcanal, and the battle took its name from this point.

Battle of Cape Gloucester.headline: Bitka pri rtu Gloucester
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Gloucester je potekala od 26. decembra 1943 do 16. januarja 1944 med japonskimi in zavezniškimi silami na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, na otoku Nova Britanija na ozemlju Nova Gvineja. Ameriško izkrcanje s kodnim imenom operacija Backhander je bilo del širše operacije Kolo (Cartwheel), glavne zavezniške strategije na poveljniških območjih jugozahodnega Pacifika in Tihega oceana v letih 1943–1944. Za ameriško 1. divizijo marincev je bilo to drugo izkrcanje v vojni, po Guadalcanalu. Cilj operacije je bil zavzeti japonski letališči pri rtu Gloucester, ki so ju branile enote japonske 17. divizije.

source.title: Battle of Cape Gloucester
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Gloucester was fought in the Pacific theater of World War II between Japanese and Allied forces on the island of New Britain, Territory of New Guinea, between 26 December 1943 and 16 January 1944. Codenamed Operation Backhander, the US landing formed part of the wider Operation Cartwheel, the main Allied strategy in the South West Pacific Area and Pacific Ocean Areas during 1943–1944. It was the second landing the US 1st Marine Division had conducted during the war thus far, after Guadalcanal. The objective of the operation was to capture the two Japanese airfields near Cape Gloucester that were defended by elements of the Japanese 17th Division.

Battle of Cape St. George.headline: Bitka pri rtu St. George
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu St. George je bila pomorska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekala 25. novembra 1943 med rtom St. George na Novi Irski in otokom Buka (danes v provinci Severni Salomonovi otoki v Papui Novi Gvineji). Bila je zadnji spopad površinskih ladij v kampanji na Salomonovih otokih. Pet rušilcev ameriške vojne mornarice pod vodstvom kapitana bojne ladje Arleigha Burka je prestreglo podobno močno japonsko skupino, ki je na Buki izkrcala okrepitve in se umikala proti Rabaulu. V boju, ki je sledil, so Američani potopili tri japonske rušilce in enega poškodovali, sami pa niso imeli izgub.

source.title: Battle of Cape St. George
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape St. George was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II fought on 25 November 1943, between Cape St. George, New Ireland, and Buka Island (now part of the North Solomons Province in Papua New Guinea). It was the last engagement of surface ships in the Solomon Islands campaign. During the engagement, a force of five US Navy destroyers led by Captain Arleigh Burke intercepted a similar sized Japanese force that was withdrawing from Buka towards Rabaul, having landed reinforcements on the island. In the ensuing fight, three Japanese destroyers were sunk and one was damaged, with no losses amongst the US forces.

Battle of Edson's Ridge.headline: Bitka na Edsonovem grebenu
paragraphs: Bitka na Edsonovem grebenu, znana tudi kot bitka na Krvavem grebenu, bitka na grebenu Raiders in bitka na grebenu, je bila kopenska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne med japonsko cesarsko kopensko vojsko in zavezniškimi kopenskimi silami, predvsem ameriškimi marinci. Potekala je od 12. do 14. septembra 1942 na Guadalcanalu na Salomonovih otokih in je bila druga od treh ločenih velikih japonskih kopenskih ofenziv v guadalcanalski kampanji.

Ameriški marinci pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generalmajorja Alexandra Vandegrifta so odbili napad japonske 35. pehotne brigade, ki ji je poveljeval generalmajor Kijotake Kavaguči. Marinci so branili obrambni obroč pri Lungi, ki je varoval Hendersonovo letališče na Guadalcanalu; zavezniki so ga Japoncem odvzeli ob izkrcanju 7. avgusta 1942. Kavagučijevo enoto so na Guadalcanal poslali kot odgovor na zavezniško izkrcanje, z nalogo, da ponovno zavzame letališče in prežene zavezniške sile z otoka.

source.title: Battle of Edson's Ridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Edson's Ridge, also known as the Battle of the Bloody Ridge, Battle of Raiders Ridge, and Battle of the Ridge, was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Army and Allied (mainly United States Marine Corps) ground forces. It took place from 12 to 14 September 1942, on Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands, and was the second of three separate major Japanese ground offensives during the Guadalcanal campaign.

In the battle, U.S. Marines under the overall command of U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift repulsed an attack by the Japanese 35th Infantry Brigade under the command of Japanese Major General Kiyotake Kawaguchi. The Marines were defending the Lunga perimeter that guarded Henderson Field on Guadalcanal, which was captured from the Japanese by the Allies in landings on Guadalcanal on 7 August 1942. Kawaguchi's unit was sent to Guadalcanal in response to the Allied landings with the mission of recapturing the airfield and driving the Allied forces from the island.

Battle of Empress Augusta Bay.headline: Bitka v zalivu Empress Augusta
paragraphs: Bitka v zalivu Empress Augusta 1. in 2. novembra 1943 – znana tudi kot bitka v zalivu Gazelle, operacija Cherry Blossom, v japonskih virih pa kot pomorska bitka pri otoku Bougainville (ブーゲンビル島沖海戦) – je bila nočna pomorska bitka v zalivu Empress Augusta blizu otoka Bougainville. Do nje je prišlo zaradi zavezniškega izkrcanja pri rtu Torokina, prve akcije kampanje na Bougainvillu v drugi svetovni vojni. Lahko jo štejemo tudi za del kampanj na Salomonovih otokih in Novi Gvineji. Bitka je bila pomembna kot del širše zavezniške strategije, operacije Kolo (Cartwheel), katere cilj je bil osamiti in obkoliti veliko japonsko oporišče v Rabaulu. Zavezniki so na Bougainvillu nameravali vzpostaviti mostišče in na njem zgraditi letališče.
notes: The bay keeps its English name; no established Slovenian form was found.

source.title: Battle of Empress Augusta Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Empress Augusta Bay, on 1–2 November 1943 – also known as the Battle of Gazelle Bay, Operation Cherry Blossom, and in Japanese sources as the Sea Battle off Bougainville Island (ブーゲンビル島沖海戦) – was a naval battle fought at night in Empress Augusta Bay near Bougainville Island. The naval battle was a result of Allied landings at Cape Torokina in the first action in the Bougainville campaign of World War II. It may also be considered as part of the Solomons and New Guinea campaigns. The battle was significant as part of a broader Allied strategy—known as Operation Cartwheel—aimed at isolating and surrounding the major Japanese base at Rabaul. The intention was to establish a beachhead on Bougainville, within which an airfield would be built.

Battle of Guam (1941).headline: Bitka za Guam (1941)
paragraphs: Bitka za Guam je bila spopad med Japonsko in Združenimi državami Amerike v vojni na Pacifiku med drugo svetovno vojno; potekala je od 8. do 10. decembra 1941 na Guamu na Marianskih otokih. Japonske sile so ameriško posadko premagale 10. decembra, otok pa so nato zasedale do druge bitke za Guam leta 1944.

source.title: Battle of Guam (1941)
paragraphs: The Battle of Guam was an engagement during the Pacific War in World War II that took place from 8 to 10 December 1941 on Guam in the Mariana Islands between Japan and the United States. The American garrison was defeated by Japanese forces on 10 December, which resulted in an occupation until the Second Battle of Guam in 1944.

Battle of Guam (1944).headline: Bitka za Guam (1944)
paragraphs: V bitki za Guam (21. julij – 10. avgust 1944) na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne so Američani ponovno zavzeli Guam, ameriško ozemlje na Marianskih otokih, ki so ga Japonci osvojili v prvi bitki za Guam leta 1941. Bitka je bila ključni del operacije Forager. Ponovno zavzetje Guama in širša kampanja na Marianskih otokih in Palauu sta uničila velik del japonskega pomorskega letalstva, Združenim državam pa omogočila, da so zgradile velika letalska oporišča, iz katerih so lahko z novim strateškim bombnikom Boeing B-29 Superfortress bombardirale japonske matične otoke.

source.title: Battle of Guam (1944)
paragraphs: The Battle of Guam (21 July – 10 August 1944) was the American recapture of the Japanese-held island of Guam, an American territory in the Mariana Islands captured by the Japanese in the First Battle of Guam in 1941 during the Pacific campaign of World War II. The battle was a critical component of Operation Forager. The recapture of Guam and the broader Mariana and Palau Islands campaign resulted in the destruction of much of Japan's naval air power and allowed the United States to establish large airbases from which it could bomb the Japanese home islands with its new strategic bomber, the Boeing B-29 Superfortress.

Battle of Kolombangara.headline: Bitka pri Kolombangari
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kolombangari (japonsko: コロンバンガラ島沖海戦), znana tudi kot druga bitka v zalivu Kula, je bila pomorska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne; potekala je v noči z 12. na 13. julij 1943 ob severovzhodni obali Kolombangare na Salomonovih otokih. Spopad se je zgodil v začetni fazi kampanje na Novi Georgii, ko je skupina ameriških in novozelandskih lahkih križark in rušilcev prestregla enote japonske cesarske mornarice, ki so okrepitve prevažale proti jugu v Vilo. Japonci so v boju potopili en zavezniški rušilec in poškodovali tri križarke. Na zahodno obalo Kolombangare jim je uspelo izkrcati 1200 vojakov, pri tem pa so izgubili eno lahko križarko.

source.title: Battle of Kolombangara
paragraphs: The Battle of Kolombangara (Japanese: コロンバンガラ島沖海戦) (also known as the Second Battle of Kula Gulf) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought on the night of 12/13 July 1943, off the northeastern coast of Kolombangara in the Solomon Islands. The battle took place during the early stages of the New Georgia campaign when an Imperial Japanese Navy force, carrying reinforcements south to Vila, Solomon Islands, was intercepted by a task force of U.S. and New Zealand light cruisers and destroyers. In the ensuing action, the Japanese sank one Allied destroyer and damaged three cruisers. They were also able to successfully land 1,200 ground troops on the western coast of Kolombangara but lost one light cruiser sunk in the process.

Battle of Kula Gulf.headline: Bitka v zalivu Kula
paragraphs: Bitka v zalivu Kula (japonsko: クラ湾夜戦) je potekala v zgodnjih jutranjih urah 6. julija 1943 med drugo svetovno vojno. V njej so se ob vzhodni obali Kolombangare na Salomonovih otokih spopadle ameriške in japonske ladje. Do nje je prišlo v začetni fazi kampanje na Novi Georgii, ko so križarke in rušilci ameriške vojne mornarice prestregli japonsko skupino, ki je izkrcavala okrepitve v Vili. V spopadu je potonila ena ameriška lahka križarka, Japonci pa so izgubili dva rušilca, dva nadaljnja sta bila poškodovana. Japonci so se po spopadu umaknili, potem ko so izkrcali 1600 vojakov.

source.title: Battle of Kula Gulf
paragraphs: The Battle of Kula Gulf (Japanese: クラ湾夜戦) took place in the early hours of 6 July 1943 during World War II. The battle involved United States and Japanese ships off the eastern coast of Kolombangara in the Solomon Islands. It took place during the early stages of the New Georgia campaign when a Japanese force landing reinforcements at Vila was intercepted by a force of US Navy cruisers and destroyers. One US light cruiser was sunk during the engagement while two Japanese destroyers were sunk and two more were damaged. The Japanese withdrew after the engagement, having landed 1,600 troops.

Battle of Makin.headline: Bitka za Makin
paragraphs: Bitka za Makin je bila spopad na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekal od 20. do 24. novembra 1943 na atolu Makin na Gilbertovih otokih.

source.title: Battle of Makin
paragraphs: The Battle of Makin was an engagement of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought from 20 to 24 November 1943 on Makin Atoll in the Gilbert Islands.

Battle of Milne Bay.headline: Bitka v zalivu Milne
paragraphs: Bitka v zalivu Milne (25. avgust – 7. september 1942), pri Japoncih znana kot operacija RE ali bitka pri Rabiju (ラビの戦い), je bila bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Japonska mornariška pehota, imenovana Kaigun Tokubecu Rikusentai (posebne mornariške desantne sile), je z dvema majhnima tankoma napadla zavezniška letališča v zalivu Milne na vzhodnem rtiču Nove Gvineje. Japonci so zaradi slabega obveščevalnega dela napačno ocenili velikost pretežno avstralske posadke. Ker so menili, da letališča branijo le dve ali tri čete, so 25. avgusta 1942 sprva izkrcali sile v velikosti približno enega bataljona. Zavezniki, ki so jih obveščevalni podatki Ultra vnaprej opozorili, so posadko močno okrepili.

source.title: Battle of Milne Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Milne Bay (25 August – 7 September 1942), also known as Operation RE or the Battle of Rabi (ラビの戦い) by the Japanese, was a battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II. Japanese naval infantry, known as Kaigun Tokubetsu Rikusentai (Special Naval Landing Forces), with two small tanks attacked the Allied airfields at Milne Bay that had been established on the eastern tip of New Guinea. Due to poor intelligence work, the Japanese miscalculated the size of the predominantly Australian garrison and, believing that the airfields were defended by only two or three companies, initially landed a force roughly equivalent in size to one battalion on 25 August 1942. The Allies, forewarned by intelligence from Ultra, had heavily reinforced the garrison.

Battle of Mount Austen, the Galloping Ho.headline: Bitka za goro Austen, Galopirajočega konja in Morskega konjička
paragraphs: Bitka za goro Austen, Galopirajočega konja in Morskega konjička, katere del se včasih imenuje bitka za Gifu, pri Japoncih pa bitka na Krvavi gori, je potekala od 15. decembra 1942 do 23. januarja 1943. Bila je predvsem spopad ameriških in japonskih cesarskih sil v gričevju ob reki Matanikau na Guadalcanalu med guadalcanalsko kampanjo. Ameriškim silam je vrhovno poveljeval generalmajor Alexander Patch, japonskim pa generalpodpolkovnik Harukiči Hjakutake.

Ameriški vojaki in marinci so s pomočjo domačinov s Salomonovih otokov napadli enote japonske cesarske kopenske vojske, ki so branile dobro utrjene in vkopane položaje na več gričih in grebenih. Najvidnejše griče so Američani poimenovali gora Austen, Galopirajoči konj in Morski konjiček. Združene države so skušale uničiti japonske sile na Guadalcanalu, Japonci pa so poskušali obdržati obrambne položaje do prihoda okrepitev.

source.title: Battle of Mount Austen, the Galloping Horse, and the Sea Horse
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Austen, the Galloping Horse, and the Sea Horse, part of which is sometimes called the Battle of the Gifu, or the Battle of the Mountain of Blood among the Japanese, took place from 15 December 1942 to 23 January 1943 and was primarily an engagement between United States and Imperial Japanese forces in the hills near the Matanikau River area on Guadalcanal during the Guadalcanal campaign. The U.S. forces were under the overall command of Major General Alexander Patch and the Japanese forces were under the overall command of Lieutenant General Harukichi Hyakutake.

In the battle, U.S. soldiers and Marines, assisted by native Solomon Islanders, attacked Imperial Japanese Army forces defending well-fortified and entrenched positions on several hills and ridges. The most prominent hills were called Mount Austen, the Galloping Horse, and the Sea Horse by the Americans. The U.S. was attempting to destroy the Japanese forces on Guadalcanal, and the Japanese were trying to hold their defensive positions until reinforcements could arrive.

Battle of Rabaul (1942).headline: Bitka za Rabaul (1942)
paragraphs: Bitka za Rabaul, pri Japoncih znana kot operacija R, je bila uvodni spopad kampanje na Novi Gvineji; potekala je od 23. januarja do februarja 1942 na otoku Nova Britanija na avstralskem ozemlju Nova Gvineja. Za zaveznike je bila strateško pomemben poraz na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne: japonske invazijske sile so hitro strle majhno avstralsko posadko, večina njenih vojakov je padla ali pristala v ujetništvu. Spopade na sosednjem otoku Nova Irska običajno štejejo za del iste bitke. Rabaul je bil pomemben, ker je ležal blizu japonskega ozemlja na Karolinskih otokih, kjer je bilo na Truku veliko oporišče japonske cesarske mornarice.

source.title: Battle of Rabaul (1942)
paragraphs: The Battle of Rabaul, also known by the Japanese as Operation R, an instigating action of the New Guinea campaign, was fought on the island of New Britain in the Australian Territory of New Guinea, from 23 January into February 1942. It was a strategically significant defeat of Allied forces by Japan in the Pacific campaign of World War II, with the Japanese invasion force quickly overwhelming the small Australian garrison, the majority of which was either killed or captured. Hostilities on the neighbouring island of New Ireland are usually considered to be part of the same battle. Rabaul was significant because of its proximity to the Japanese territory of the Caroline Islands, site of a major Imperial Japanese Navy base on Truk.

Battle of Savo Island.headline: Bitka pri otoku Savo
paragraphs: Bitka pri otoku Savo, znana tudi kot prva bitka pri otoku Savo, v japonskih virih kot prva bitka v Salomonovem morju (第一次ソロモン海戦, Dai-ichi-ji Soromon Kaisen), med zavezniškimi veterani z Guadalcanala pa pogovorno kot bitka petih lahkih tarč (Battle of the Five Sitting Ducks), je bila pomorska bitka med japonsko cesarsko mornarico in zavezniškimi pomorskimi silami v kampanji na Salomonovih otokih, v vojni na Pacifiku med drugo svetovno vojno. Potekala je 8. in 9. avgusta 1942 in je bila prva velika pomorska bitka guadalcanalske kampanje ter prva od več pomorskih bitk v ožinah blizu Guadalcanala, ki so jih pozneje poimenovali Ironbottom Sound (ožina železnega dna).
notes: The veterans' nickname is given in sense (lahke tarče) with the English in brackets; a literal 'sedeče race' would lose the idiom.

source.title: Battle of Savo Island
paragraphs: The Battle of Savo Island, also known as the First Battle of Savo Island and in Japanese sources as the First Battle of the Solomon Sea (第一次ソロモン海戦, Dai-ichi-ji Soromon Kaisen), and colloquially among Allied Guadalcanal veterans as the Battle of the Five Sitting Ducks, was a naval battle during the Solomon Islands campaign of the Pacific War of World War II between the Imperial Japanese Navy and Allied naval forces. The battle took place on 8–9 August 1942 and was the first major naval engagement of the Guadalcanal campaign, the first of several naval battles in the straits later named Ironbottom Sound, near the island of Guadalcanal.

Battle of Tassafaronga.headline: Bitka pri Tassafarongi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tassafarongi, včasih imenovana četrta bitka pri otoku Savo, v japonskih virih pa bitka pri rtu Lunga (ルンガ沖夜戦, »nočna pomorska bitka pri Lungi«), je bila nočna pomorska bitka med vojnimi ladjami ameriške vojne mornarice in japonske cesarske mornarice 30. novembra 1942 v guadalcanalski kampanji. Potekala je v ožini Ironbottom Sound blizu rta Tassafaronga na Guadalcanalu.

source.title: Battle of Tassafaronga
paragraphs: The Battle of Tassafaronga, sometimes referred to as the Fourth Battle of Savo Island or in Japanese sources as the Battle of Lunga Point (ルンガ沖夜戦; "Naval Battle of Lunga"), was a nighttime naval battle that took place on 30 November 1942 between United States Navy and Imperial Japanese Navy warships during the Guadalcanal campaign. The battle took place in Ironbottom Sound near Tassafaronga Point on Guadalcanal.

Battle of the Tenaru.headline: Bitka ob reki Tenaru
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Tenaru, včasih imenovana bitka ob reki Ilu ali bitka pri Alligator Creeku, je bila kopenska bitka med japonsko cesarsko kopensko vojsko in zavezniškimi kopenskimi silami, ki je potekala 21. avgusta 1942 na otoku Guadalcanal na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Bila je prva velika japonska kopenska ofenziva v guadalcanalski kampanji.

Ameriški marinci pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generalmajorja Alexandra Vandegrifta so odbili napad »prvega ešalona« polka »Ičiki«, ki mu je poveljeval polkovnik Kijonao Ičiki. Marinci so branili obrambni obroč pri Lungi, ki je varoval Hendersonovo letališče; zavezniki so ga zavzeli ob izkrcanju na Guadalcanalu 7. avgusta. Ičikijevo enoto so na Guadalcanal poslali kot odgovor na zavezniško izkrcanje, z nalogo, da ponovno zavzame letališče in prežene zavezniške sile z otoka.

source.title: Battle of the Tenaru
paragraphs: The Battle of the Tenaru, sometimes called the Battle of the Ilu River or the Battle of Alligator Creek, was a land battle between the Imperial Japanese Army and Allied ground forces that took place on 21 August 1942, on the island of Guadalcanal during the Pacific campaign of World War II. The battle was the first major Japanese land offensive during the Guadalcanal campaign.

In the battle, U.S. Marines, under the overall command of U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift, repulsed an assault by the "First Element" of the "Ichiki" Regiment, under the command of Japanese Colonel Kiyonao Ichiki. The Marines were defending the Lunga perimeter that guarded Henderson Field which had been captured by the Allies in landings on Guadalcanal on 7 August. Ichiki's unit was sent to Guadalcanal in response to the Allied landings there with the mission of recapturing the airfield and driving the Allied forces off the island.

Battle of Tinian.headline: Bitka za Tinian
paragraphs: Bitka za Tinian, del kampanje na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, je med Združenimi državami in Japonsko potekala od 24. julija do 1. avgusta 1944 na otoku Tinian na Marianskih otokih. V njej so prvič uporabili napalm.

Na konferenci v Kairu decembra 1943 so ameriški in britanski združeni načelniki štabov podprli dvosmerni napad prek osrednjega in jugozahodnega Pacifika. Admiral Chester W. Nimitz, vrhovni poveljnik pacifiških območij, je 12. marca 1944 dobil ukaz, naj onesposobi Truk in zasede Marianske otoke. Marianski otoki so bili tarča, ker so ležali na japonskih oskrbovalnih poteh. Tinian je ležal preblizu Saipana, da bi ga lahko obšli in pustili v japonskih rokah. Po koncu bitke za Saipan 9. julija je V. amfibijski korpus generalmajorja Harryja Schmidta začel priprave na invazijo bližnjega Tiniana.

source.title: Battle of Tinian
paragraphs: The Battle of Tinian was part of the Pacific campaign of World War II. It was fought between the United States and Japan on the island of Tinian in the Mariana Islands from 24 July until 1 August 1944. The battle saw napalm used for the first time.

At the Cairo Conference in December 1943, the US and British Combined Chiefs of Staff endorsed a two-pronged attack through the Central Pacific and Southwest Pacific Areas. On 12 March 1944, the Commander in Chief, Pacific Ocean Areas, Admiral Chester W. Nimitz, was directed to neutralize Truk and occupy the Mariana Islands. The Mariana Islands were targeted because of their location astride the Japanese line of communications. Tinian lay too close to Saipan to allow it to be bypassed and remain in Japanese hands. Following the conclusion of the Battle of Saipan on 9 July, Major General Harry Schmidt's V Amphibious Corps began preparations to invade nearby Tinian.

Battle of Tulagi and Gavutu–Tanambogo.headline: Bitka za Tulagi in Gavutu–Tanambogo
paragraphs: Bitka za Tulagi in Gavutu–Tanambogo je bila kopenska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne med silami japonske cesarske mornarice in zavezniškimi kopenskimi silami, predvsem ameriškimi marinci. Potekala je od 7. do 9. avgusta 1942 na Salomonovih otokih, ob prvih zavezniških izkrcanjih v guadalcanalski kampanji.

Ameriški marinci 1. divizije marincev pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Alexandra Vandegrifta in invazijske sile pod vodstvom brigadnega generala Williama Rupertusa so zavzeli otoke Tulagi, Gavutu in Tanambogo, kjer je japonska mornarica zgradila pomorsko oporišče in oporišče za hidroplane. Vojaki japonske mornarice so se izkrcanju srdito upirali; čeprav so imeli zavezniki veliko številčno in ognjeno premoč, so se borili in padli skoraj do zadnjega moža.

source.title: Battle of Tulagi and Gavutu–Tanambogo
paragraphs: The Battle of Tulagi and Gavutu–Tanambogo was a land battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, between the forces of the Imperial Japanese Navy and Allied (mainly United States Marine Corps) ground forces. It took place 7–9 August 1942 on the Solomon Islands, during the initial Allied landings in the Guadalcanal campaign.

U.S. Marines of the 1st Marine Division, commanded by U.S. Major General Alexander Vandegrift, and the invasion force under Brigadier General William Rupertus, captured the islands of Tulagi, Gavutu, and Tanambogo. The Japanese Navy had built a naval and seaplane base on these islands. The landings were fiercely resisted by the Japanese Navy troops who, heavily outnumbered and outgunned by the Allied forces, fought and died almost to the last man.

Battle of Vella Gulf.headline: Bitka v zalivu Vella
paragraphs: Bitka v zalivu Vella (ベラ湾夜戦, Berawan yasen) je bila pomorska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekala v noči s 6. na 7. avgust 1943 v zalivu Vella med otokoma Vella Lavella in Kolombangara na Salomonovih otokih v jugozahodnem Pacifiku.
V tej bitki so ameriški rušilci med pacifiško kampanjo prvič smeli delovati neodvisno od ameriških križark.

Šest ameriških rušilcev je imelo obveščevalne podatke, da bo tisto noč v zaliv Vella priplula japonska skupina, in jo je čakalo v zasedi. Spopadli so se s štirimi japonskimi rušilci, ki so skušali pripeljati okrepitve japonskim enotam na Kolombangari. Ameriške ladje so se z radarjem neopažene približale japonski skupini, izstrelile torpeda in potopile tri japonske rušilce, same pa niso bile poškodovane.
notes: The source names the six American destroyers twice in one paragraph; the repetition is merged.

source.title: Battle of Vella Gulf
paragraphs: The Battle of Vella Gulf (ベラ湾夜戦, Berawan yasen) was a naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II fought on the night of 6–7 August 1943 in Vella Gulf between Vella Lavella and Kolombangara in the Solomon Islands of the southwest Pacific.
This engagement was the first time that American destroyers were allowed to operate independently of the American cruiser force during the Pacific campaign.

In the battle, six American destroyers had intelligence that a Japanese group was coming to Vella Gulf on that night, and laid in wait for them. In the battle, six American destroyers engaged four Japanese destroyers attempting to reinforce Japanese troops on Kolombangara. The American warships closed the Japanese force undetected with the aid of radar and fired torpedoes, sinking three Japanese destroyers with no damage to American ships.

Battle of Wau.headline: Bitka za Wau
paragraphs: Bitka za Wau (29. januar – 4. februar 1943) je bila bitka v kampanji na Novi Gvineji med drugo svetovno vojno. Sile Japonskega cesarstva so iz Rabaula prečkale Salomonovo morje in kljub zavezniškim letalskim napadom uspešno priplule do Laeja, kjer so se izkrcale. Japonski vojaki so nato po kopnem napredovali proti Wauju, avstralskemu oporišču, ki je lahko ogrožalo japonske položaje pri Salamaui in Laeju. Začela se je tekma med Japonci, ki so napredovali po kopnem in jih je oviral teren, ter Avstralci, ki so prihajali po zraku in jih je oviralo vreme. Ko so Japonci po pohodu čez gore prispeli na območje Wauja, so avstralski branilci že dobili močne okrepitve po zraku. Japonski napadalci v bitki, ki je sledila, Wauja niso zavzeli, čeprav so z napadom iz nepričakovane smeri dosegli taktično presenečenje.

source.title: Battle of Wau
paragraphs: The Battle of Wau (29 January – 4 February 1943) was a battle in the New Guinea campaign of World War II. Forces of the Empire of Japan sailed from Rabaul and crossed the Solomon Sea and, despite Allied air attacks, successfully reached Lae, where they disembarked. Japanese troops then advanced overland on Wau, an Australian base that potentially threatened the Japanese positions at Salamaua and Lae. A race developed between the Japanese moving overland, hampered by the terrain, and the Australians, moving by air, hampered by the weather. By the time the Japanese reached the Wau area after a trek over the mountains, the Australian defenders had been greatly reinforced by air. In the battle that followed, despite achieving tactical surprise by approaching from an unexpected direction, the Japanese attackers were unable to capture Wau.

Battle off Horaniu.headline: Bitka pri Horaniuju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Horaniuju (japonsko: 第一次ベララベラ海戦) je bila manjša pomorska bitka na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne blizu otoka Vella Lavella na Salomonovih otokih. V noči s 17. na 18. avgust 1943 so štirje rušilci ameriške vojne mornarice prestregli konvoj japonske cesarske mornarice, ki je prevažal vojake v Horaniu na severni obali Vella Lavelle, kjer so nameravali vzpostaviti oporišče za barke, ki bi podpiralo premike vojakov po tem območju.

Japonski konvoj so spremljali štirje rušilci in obe strani sta si z velike razdalje izmenjali torpeda in topniški ogenj. Ko sta bila dva japonska rušilca laže poškodovana, se je spremstvo umaknilo, ameriška skupina pa je potopila pet manjših ladij iz konvoja. Večina bark z vojaki je vendarle ušla, ker se je skrila ob obali Vella Lavelle, in je nalogo dokončala 19. avgusta. Oktobra so Japonci oporišče uporabili pri množičnem umiku vojakov s Kolombangare.

source.title: Battle off Horaniu
paragraphs: The Battle off Horaniu (Japanese: 第一次ベララベラ海戦) was a minor naval battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II, fought near Vella Lavella in the Solomon Islands. On the night of 17–18 August 1943, four United States Navy destroyers intercepted an Imperial Japanese Navy convoy carrying troops to Horaniu, on the northern coast of Vella Lavella, where they were to establish a barge base to support the movement of troops through the region.

The Japanese convoy was escorted by four destroyers, and both sides exchanged torpedoes and gunfire from long range. After two Japanese destroyers were slightly damaged, the escort withdrew, allowing the U.S. force to sink five small ships from the convoy. However, the majority of the troop-carrying barges escaped by hiding along the Vella Lavella coast and subsequently completed their mission on 19 August. In October, the Japanese used the base to support the mass withdrawal of troops from Kolombangara.

Black War.headline: Črna vojna
paragraphs: Črna vojna je bila obdobje nasilnih spopadov med britanskimi kolonisti in tasmanskimi Aborigini na Tasmaniji od sredine 1820. let do leta 1832, ki je privedlo do skoraj popolnega iztrebljenja staroselskega prebivalstva. Obe strani sta se večinoma bojevali gverilsko; umrlo je od 600 do 900 Aboriginov in več kot 200 britanskih kolonistov.

source.title: Black War
paragraphs: The Black War was a period of violent conflict between British colonists and Aboriginal Tasmanians in Tasmania from the mid-1820s to 1832 which precipitated the near-extermination of the Indigenous population. The conflict was fought largely as a guerrilla war by both sides; some 600 to 900 Aboriginal Australians and more than 200 British colonists died.

Bombardment of Papeete.headline: Obstreljevanje Papeeteja
paragraphs: Nemške vojne ladje so 22. septembra 1914, med prvo svetovno vojno, napadle in obstreljevale Papeete v Francoski Polineziji. Nemški oklepni križarki SMS Scharnhorst in Gneisenau sta vpluli v pristanišče Papeete na Tahitiju ter potopili francosko topnjačo Zélée in tovorno ladjo Walküre, nato pa obstreljevali mestne utrdbe. Francoske obalne baterije in topnjača so se nemškemu vdoru upirale, a so imele veliko šibkejšo oborožitev. Glavni nemški cilj je bil zaseči zaloge premoga na otoku, vendar so jih Francozi uničili že na začetku spopada.

source.title: Bombardment of Papeete
paragraphs: The Bombardment of Papeete occurred in French Polynesia when German warships attacked on 22 September 1914, during World War I. The German armoured cruisers SMS Scharnhorst and Gneisenau entered the port of Papeete on the island of Tahiti and sank the French gunboat Zélée and freighter Walküre before bombarding the town's fortifications. French shore batteries and a gunboat resisted the German intrusion but were greatly outgunned. The main German objective was to seize the coal piles stored on the island, but these were destroyed by the French at the start of the action.

Bombing of Darwin.headline: Bombardiranje Darwina
paragraphs: Japonci so 19. februarja 1942 v dveh ločenih napadih s 188 letali bombardirali avstralsko mesto Darwin, ladje v darwinskem pristanišču in obe mestni letališči. Med drugo svetovno vojno so hoteli preprečiti, da bi jih zavezniki uporabili kot oporišča za boj proti invaziji na Timor in Javo. To je največji posamični napad, ki ga je tuja sila kdaj izvedla na Avstralijo.

Darwin je bil glede na obseg napada zelo šibko branjen in Japonci so zaveznikom zadali hude izgube, sami pa so jih utrpeli malo. Napadi so poškodovali tudi mestne predele Darwina, bilo je nekaj civilnih žrtev. Več kot polovica civilnega prebivalstva je mesto pred napadom ali takoj po njem za vedno zapustila.

Japonska letalska napada sta bila prvi in največji od več kot 100 letalskih napadov na Avstralijo v letih 1942–1943. Bombardiranje je bilo le štiri dni po padcu Singapurja, ko so se združene sile Commonwealtha predale Japoncem – to je bila največja vdaja v britanski zgodovini.

source.title: Bombing of Darwin
paragraphs: On 19 February 1942, 188 Japanese aircraft, in two separate raids, bombed the Australian town of Darwin, ships in Darwin Harbour and the town's two airfields in an attempt to prevent the Allies from using them as bases to contest the invasion of Timor and Java during World War II. This was the largest single attack ever mounted by a foreign power on Australia.

Darwin was very lightly defended relative to the size of this attack, and the Japanese inflicted heavy losses upon Allied forces at little cost to themselves. The urban areas of Darwin also suffered some damage from the raids and there were a number of civilian casualties. More than half of Darwin's civilian population left the area permanently, before or immediately after the attack.

The two Japanese air raids were the first, and largest, of more than 100 air raids against Australia during 1942–1943. The event happened just four days after the Fall of Singapore, when a combined Commonwealth force surrendered to the Japanese, the largest surrender in British history.

Bougainville campaign.headline: Kampanja na Bougainvillu
paragraphs: Kampanja na Bougainvillu je bila vrsta kopenskih in pomorskih bitk med zavezniki in Japonskim cesarstvom na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne, imenovana po otoku Bougainville, enem od Salomonovih otokov. Bila je del operacije Kolo (Cartwheel), velike zavezniške strategije v južnem Pacifiku.

Kampanja je na severnih Salomonovih otokih potekala v dveh fazah. V prvi, od novembra 1943 do novembra 1944, so se ameriške enote izkrcale in držale obrambni obroč okoli mostišča pri Torokini. V drugi so od novembra 1944 predvsem avstralske enote prešle v napad in čistile žepe izstradanih in osamljenih, a še vedno odločnih Japoncev, dokler se avgusta 1945 niso predali zadnji japonski vojaki na otoku. V zadnji fazi so avstralske sile napredovale proti severu do polotoka Bonis in proti jugu do glavnega japonskega oporišča pri Buinu, vendar se je vojna končala, preden sta bili ti enklavi povsem uničeni.

source.title: Bougainville campaign
paragraphs: The Bougainville campaign was a series of land and naval battles of the Pacific campaign of World War II between Allied forces and the Empire of Japan, named after the island of Bougainville, one of the Solomon Islands. It was part of Operation Cartwheel, the Allied grand strategy in the South Pacific.

The campaign took place in the Northern Solomons in two phases. The first phase, in which American troops landed and held the perimeter around the beachhead at Torokina, lasted from November 1943 through November 1944. The second phase, in which primarily Australian troops went on the offensive, mopping up pockets of starving, isolated but still-determined Japanese, lasted from November 1944 until August 1945, when the last Japanese soldiers on the island surrendered. Operations during the final phase of the campaign saw the Australian forces advance north towards the Bonis Peninsula and south towards the main Japanese stronghold around Buin, although the war ended before these two enclaves were completely destroyed.

Bougainville conflict.headline: Konflikt na Bougainvillu
paragraphs: Konflikt na Bougainvillu, znan tudi kot bougainvillska državljanska vojna, salomonska državljanska vojna ali državljanska vojna na Severnih Salomonovih otokih, je bil večplasten oborožen spopad, ki je med letoma 1988 in 1998 potekal v provinci Severni Salomonovi otoki v Papui Novi Gvineji. Na eni strani so bile vlade Papue Nove Gvineje, Avstralije in Indonezije, na drugi odcepitvene sile Bougainvillske revolucionarne vojske (BRA), preostanek Salomonovih otokov in domnevno Fidži; spopadi so potekali tudi med BRA in drugimi oboroženimi skupinami na Bougainvillu. Bougainvillski predsednik John Momis ga je označil za največji spopad v Oceaniji po koncu druge svetovne vojne leta 1945: po ocenah je umrlo od 15.000 do 20.000 prebivalcev Bougainvilla, nekatere ocene pa navajajo le od 1000 do 2000 mrtvih.

source.title: Bougainville conflict
paragraphs: The Bougainville conflict, also known as the Bougainvillean Civil War, the Solomon Civil War or the Civil War of the North Solomons was a multi-layered armed conflict fought from 1988 to 1998 in the North Solomons Province of Papua New Guinea between the governments of Papua New Guinea, Australia and Indonesia and the secessionist forces of the Bougainville Revolutionary Army (BRA), the rest of the Solomon Islands and allegedly Fiji, and between the BRA and other armed groups on Bougainville. The conflict was described by Bougainvillean President John Momis as the largest conflict in Oceania since the end of World War II in 1945, with an estimated 15,000–20,000 Bougainvilleans dead, although some estimates place the toll as low as between 1,000 and 2,000.

Coconut War.headline: Kokosova vojna
paragraphs: Kokosova vojna je bila kratek spopad med vojaki Papue Nove Gvineje in uporniki na otoku Espiritu Santo tik pred razglasitvijo neodvisnosti Republike Vanuatu 30. julija 1980 in po njej.

source.title: Coconut War
paragraphs: The Coconut War was a brief clash between Papua New Guinean soldiers and rebels in Espiritu Santo shortly before and after the independence of the Republic of Vanuatu was declared on 30 July 1980.

Eureka Rebellion.headline: Upor Eureka
paragraphs: Upor Eureka je bil vstaja zlatokopov proti britanski upravi kolonije Viktorija v Avstraliji med viktorijansko zlato mrzlico. Vrhunec je dosegel z bitko pri Eureka Stockadu (utrdbi Eureka), ki je potekala 3. decembra 1854 v Ballaratu med uporniki in avstralskimi kolonialnimi silami. Uradno je v spopadu umrlo 27 ljudi, veliko je bilo ranjenih, večinoma upornikov. Pred tem so od leta 1851 na viktorijanskih zlatih poljih potekale mirne demonstracije in državljanska nepokorščina. Rudarji so imeli več pritožb, predvsem zaradi cene rudarskih dovoljenj in oblastnega načina, kako so sistem izvajali.

source.title: Eureka Rebellion
paragraphs: The Eureka Rebellion involved gold miners who revolted against the British administration of the colony of Victoria, Australia, during the Victorian gold rush. It culminated in the Battle of the Eureka Stockade, which took place on 3 December 1854 at Ballarat between the rebels and the colonial forces of Australia. The fighting resulted in an official total of 27 deaths and many injuries, the majority of casualties being rebels. There was a preceding period beginning in 1851 of peaceful demonstrations and civil disobedience on the Victorian goldfields. The miners had various grievances, chiefly the cost of mining permits and the officious way the system was enforced.
Peta francoska republika (francosko: Cinquième République Française) je današnji republikanski politični sistem Francije. Ustanovil jo je Charles de Gaulle 4. oktobra 1958 z ustavo Pete republike.

source.title: French Fifth Republic
paragraphs: The French Fifth Republic (French: Cinquième République Française) is France's current republican system of government. It was established on 4 October 1958 by Charles de Gaulle under the Constitution of the Fifth Republic.

Nemška Samoa, uradno Kraljestvo Samoa (nemško: Königreich Samoa, samoansko: Malo Kaisalika), je bila nemški protektorat od leta 1900 do 1920. Obsegala je otoke Upolu, Savaiʻi, Apolima in Manono, ki danes v celoti spadajo k Neodvisni državi Samoi, nekdanji Zahodni Samoi. Samoa je bila zadnja nemška kolonialna pridobitev v Tihem oceanu: Nemčija jo je dobila na podlagi tristranske konvencije, podpisane 2. decembra 1899 v Washingtonu, ratifikacijske listine pa so izmenjali 16. februarja 1900. Bila je edina nemška kolonija v Pacifiku, ki so jo – poleg zakupnega ozemlja Kiautschou na Kitajskem – upravljali ločeno od Nemške Nove Gvineje.

source.title: German Samoa
paragraphs: German Samoa, officially the Kingdom of Samoa (German: Königreich Samoa; Samoan: Malo Kaisalika), was a German protectorate from 1900 to 1920, consisting of the islands of Upolu, Savaiʻi, Apolima and Manono, now wholly within the Independent State of Samoa, formerly Western Samoa. Samoa was the last German colonial acquisition in the Pacific Ocean, received following the Tripartite Convention signed at Washington on 2 December 1899 with ratifications exchanged on 16 February 1900. It was the only German colony in the Pacific, aside from the Kiautschou Bay Leased Territory in China, that was administered separately from German New Guinea.

Guadalcanalska kampanja, znana tudi kot bitka za Guadalcanal, v Združenih državah pa s kodnim imenom operacija Watchtower, je bila zavezniška ofenziva proti silam Japonskega cesarstva na Salomonovih otokih na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Potekala je od 7. avgusta 1942 do 9. februarja 1943 z velikimi kopenskimi in pomorskimi bitkami na otoku Guadalcanal in okoli njega. Bila je prva velika zavezniška kopenska ofenziva proti Japonski v tej vojni.

Poleti 1942 so se zavezniki odločili za velike ofenzive na Novi Gvineji in Salomonovih otokih, da bi zavarovali pomorske poti do Avstralije in sčasoma napadli veliko japonsko oporišče v Rabaulu na Novi Britaniji. Operaciji na Guadalcanalu je poveljeval Robert L. Ghormley, ki je odgovarjal Chestru W. Nimitzu; japonsko obrambo sta sestavljala Združeno brodovje pod Isorokujem Jamamotom in 17. armada pod Harukičijem Hjakutakejem.
notes: The source spells the general 'Harukishi'; the translation uses Harukiči Hjakutake, as in the other stories.

source.title: Guadalcanal campaign
paragraphs: The Guadalcanal campaign, also known as the Battle of Guadalcanal and codenamed Operation Watchtower by the United States, was an Allied offensive against forces of the Empire of Japan in the Solomon Islands during the Pacific Theater of World War II. It was fought between 7 August 1942 and 9 February 1943, and involved major land and naval battles on and surrounding the island of Guadalcanal. It was the first major Allied land offensive against Japan during the war.

In summer 1942, the Allies decided to mount major offensives in New Guinea and the Solomon Islands with the objectives of defending sea lines to Australia and eventually attacking the major Japanese base at Rabaul on New Britain. The Guadalcanal operation was under the command of Robert L. Ghormley, reporting to Chester W. Nimitz, while the Japanese defense consisted of the Combined Fleet under Isoroku Yamamoto and the Seventeenth Army under Harukishi Hyakutake.

Kraljestvo Havaji (havajsko: Ke Aupuni Hawaiʻi) je bilo otoška država, ki je obstajala od leta 1795 do 1893 in je sčasoma obsegala vse naseljene Havajske otoke. Ustanovil ga je leta 1795 Kamehameha I., tedanji aliʻi nui (vrhovni poglavar) otoka Havaji, ko je osvojil otoke Oʻahu, Maui, Molokaʻi in Lānaʻi ter jih združil pod eno vlado. Leta 1810 so bili Havajski otoki povsem združeni, ko sta se kraljestvu prostovoljno pridružila otoka Kauaʻi in Niʻihau. Kraljestvu sta vladali dve veliki dinastiji, rodbina Kamehameha in rodbina Kalākaua.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Hawaiian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Hawaiian Kingdom, also known as the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi (Hawaiian: Ke Aupuni Hawaiʻi [kɛ ɐwˈpuni həˈvɐjʔi]), was an archipelagic country from 1795 to 1893, which eventually encompassed all of the inhabited Hawaiian Islands. It was established in 1795 when Kamehameha I, then Aliʻi nui of Hawaii, conquered the islands of Oʻahu, Maui, Molokaʻi, and Lānaʻi, and unified them under one government. In 1810, the Hawaiian Islands were fully unified when the islands of Kauaʻi and Niʻihau voluntarily joined the Hawaiian Kingdom. Two major dynastic families ruled the kingdom, the House of Kamehameha and the House of Kalākaua.

Invasion of Tulagi (May 1942).headline: Invazija na Tulagi (maj 1942)
paragraphs: Invazija na Tulagi 3. in 4. maja 1942 je bila del operacije Mo, strategije Japonskega cesarstva v južnem Pacifiku in na območju jugozahodnega Pacifika leta 1942. Načrt je predvideval, da enote japonske cesarske mornarice zavzamejo Tulagi in bližnje otoke v britanskem protektoratu Salomonovi otoki. Japonska zasedba Tulagija naj bi zavarovala bok japonskih sil, ki so napredovale proti Port Moresbyju na Novi Gvineji, in jim omogočila izvidovanje, poglobila obrambo velikega japonskega oporišča v Rabaulu ter služila kot oporišče, iz katerega bi japonske sile ogrožale in prekinjale oskrbovalne in komunikacijske poti med Združenimi državami ter Avstralijo in Novo Zelandijo.

source.title: Invasion of Tulagi (May 1942)
paragraphs: The invasion of Tulagi, on 3–4 May 1942, was part of Operation Mo, the Empire of Japan's strategy in the South Pacific and South West Pacific Area in 1942. The plan called for Imperial Japanese Navy troops to capture Tulagi and nearby islands in the British Solomon Islands Protectorate. The occupation of Tulagi by the Japanese was intended to cover the flank of and provide reconnaissance support for Japanese forces that were advancing on Port Moresby in New Guinea, provide greater defensive depth for the major Japanese base at Rabaul, and serve as a base for Japanese forces to threaten and interdict the supply and communication routes between the United States and Australia and New Zealand.

Kraljestvo Fidži (fidžijsko: Matanitu o Viti), znano tudi kot Kraljestvo Viti, je bilo kratkotrajna monarhija na Fidžiju. Obstajalo je od leta 1871 do 1874, njegov kralj pa je bil Ratu Seru Epenisa Cakobau.

source.title: Kingdom of Fiji
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Fiji (Fijian: Matanitu o Viti), also known as the Kingdom of Viti, was a short-lived monarchy in Fiji. It existed from 1871 to 1874, with Ratu Seru Epenisa Cakobau as King.

Kingdom of Samoa.headline: Kraljestvo Samoa
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Samoa ali Samoansko kraljestvo je bilo polinezijska monarhija, ki je od leta 1873 do 1899 obstajala na Samoanskih otokih v Polineziji. Monarhijo so odpravili s tristransko konvencijo iz leta 1899, ki je začela veljati 16. februarja 1900.

source.title: Kingdom of Samoa
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Samoa, or Samoan Kingdom, was a Polynesian monarchy that existed from 1873 to 1899 in Samoan Islands of Polynesia. The monarchy of Samoa was abolished under the Tripartite Convention of 1899, effective 16 February 1900.

Kingdom of Tahiti.headline: Kraljestvo Tahiti
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Tahiti ali Tahitijsko kraljestvo je bilo polinezijska monarhija, ki jo je ustanovil vrhovni poglavar Pōmare I. Ob pomoči britanskih misijonarjev in trgovcev ter evropskega orožja je združil otoke Tahiti, Moʼorea, Tetiʻaroa in Mehetiʻa. Kraljestvo je pozneje priključilo še otočje Tuamotu in Avstralske otoke (Rapa Iti, Rurutu, Rimatara, Tubuai, Raivavae).

Vladarji kraljestva so bili po krstu Pomareja II. kristjani. Vzpon kraljestva in priznanje Evropejcev sta Tahitiju omogočila, da je ostal svoboden: izognil se je načrtovani španski kolonizaciji in drugim evropskim zahtevam po otokih.

source.title: Kingdom of Tahiti
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Tahiti or the Tahitian Kingdom was a Polynesian monarchy founded by paramount chief Pōmare I, who, with the aid of British missionaries and traders, and European weaponry, unified the islands of Tahiti, Moʼorea, Tetiʻaroa, and Mehetiʻa. The kingdom eventually annexed the Tuamotus, and the Austral Islands (Rapa Iti, Rurutu, Rimatara, Tubuai, Raivavae).

Its leaders were Christian following the baptism of Pomare II. Its progressive rise and recognition by Europeans allowed Tahiti to remain free from a planned Spanish colonization as well as other European claims to the islands.

Kingdom of Tonga (1900–1970).headline: Kraljestvo Tonga (1900–1970)
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Tonga je bilo od leta 1900 do 1970 zaščitena država Združenega kraljestva; tega leta se je njegov status protektorata končal.

source.title: Kingdom of Tonga (1900–1970)
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Tonga was a protected state of the United Kingdom from 1900 to 1970, when its protectorate status was removed.

Kokoda Track campaign.headline: Kampanja na poti Kokoda
paragraphs: Kampanja na poti Kokoda (angleško: Kokoda Track ali Kokoda Trail) je bila del vojne na Pacifiku med drugo svetovno vojno. Sestavljala jo je vrsta bitk med julijem in novembrom 1942 na tedanjem avstralskem ozemlju Papua. Šlo je predvsem za kopenske boje med japonskim odredom Južnih morij pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Tomitara Horiija ter avstralskimi in papuanskimi kopenskimi silami pod poveljstvom Novogvinejskih sil. Japonci so hoteli zavzeti Port Moresby s kopenskim prodorom s severne obale po poti Kokoda čez gorovje Owen Stanley, kar je bilo del strategije, da bi Avstralijo odrezali od Združenih držav.

source.title: Kokoda Track campaign
paragraphs: The Kokoda Track campaign or Kokoda Trail campaign was part of the Pacific War of World War II. The campaign consisted of a series of battles fought between July and November 1942 in what was then the Australian Territory of Papua. It was primarily a land battle, between the Japanese South Seas Detachment under Major General Tomitarō Horii and Australian and Papuan land forces under command of New Guinea Force. The Japanese objective was to seize Port Moresby by an overland advance from the north coast, following the Kokoda Track over the mountains of the Owen Stanley Range, as part of a strategy to isolate Australia from the United States.

Koli Point action.headline: Spopad pri rtu Koli
paragraphs: Spopad pri rtu Koli od 3. do 12. novembra 1942 je bil boj med ameriškimi marinci in kopensko vojsko ter enotami japonske cesarske kopenske vojske okoli rta Koli na Guadalcanalu med guadalcanalsko kampanjo. Ameriškim silam je vrhovno poveljeval generalmajor Alexander Vandegrift, japonskim pa generalpodpolkovnik Harukiči Hjakutake.

Marinci 7. polka marincev in vojaki 164. pehotnega polka kopenske vojske pod taktičnim poveljstvom Williama H. Rupertusa in Edmunda B. Sebreeja so napadli zbirališče japonskih vojakov, večinoma iz 230. pehotnega polka, ki mu je poveljeval Tošinari Šodži. Šodžijevi vojaki so na območje rta Koli prikorakali po neuspelih japonskih napadih na ameriško obrambo v bitki za Hendersonovo letališče konec oktobra 1942.

source.title: Koli Point action
paragraphs: The Koli Point action, during 3–12 November 1942, was an engagement between U.S. Marine Corps and U.S. Army forces and Imperial Japanese Army forces around Koli Point on Guadalcanal during the Guadalcanal campaign. The U.S. forces were under the overall command of Major General Alexander Vandegrift, while the Japanese forces were under the overall command of Lieutenant General Harukichi Hyakutake.

U.S. Marines from the 7th Marine Regiment and U.S. Army soldiers from the 164th Infantry Regiment under the tactical command of William H. Rupertus and Edmund B. Sebree, attacked a concentration of Japanese Army troops, most of whom belonged to the 230th Infantry Regiment, commanded by Toshinari Shōji. Shōji's troops had marched to the Koli Point area after the failed Japanese assaults on U.S. defenses during the Battle for Henderson Field in late October 1942.

Musket Wars.headline: Mušketne vojne
paragraphs: Mušketne vojne so bile vrsta do 3000 bitk in napadov med Maori po vsej Novi Zelandiji (vključno s Chathamovimi otoki) med letoma 1806 in 1845. Začele so se, ko so Maori dobili prve muškete in se zapletli v oboroževalno tekmo med plemeni, da bi pridobili ozemlje ali se maščevali za pretekle poraze. V bitkah je umrlo od 20.000 do 40.000 ljudi, več deset tisoč Maorov je bilo zasužnjenih, pred podpisom pogodbe iz Waitangija leta 1840 pa so se močno spremenile tudi meje plemenskih ozemelj (rohe). Vrhunec so vojne dosegle v 1830. letih, manjši spopadi med plemeni (iwi) pa so trajali do sredine 1840. let; nekateri zgodovinarji menijo, da so bile novozelandske vojne (začele so se s spopadom v Wairauu leta 1843 in vojno Flagstaff leta 1845) nadaljevanje mušketnih vojn. Ker so muškete v medplemenskih vojnah uporabljali vse pogosteje, se je spremenila zasnova utrdb pā, kar je Maorom pozneje koristilo v bojih s kolonialnimi silami v novozelandskih vojnah.

source.title: Musket Wars
paragraphs: The Musket Wars were a series of as many as 3,000 battles and raids fought throughout New Zealand (including the Chatham Islands) among Māori between 1806 and 1845, after Māori first obtained muskets and then engaged in an intertribal arms race in order to gain territory or seek revenge for past defeats. The battles resulted in the deaths of between 20,000 and 40,000 people and the enslavement of tens of thousands of Māori and significantly altered the rohe, or tribal territorial boundaries, before the signing of the Treaty of Waitangi in 1840. The Musket Wars reached their peak in the 1830s, with smaller conflicts between iwi continuing until the mid-1840s; some historians argue the New Zealand Wars were (commencing with the Wairau Affray in 1843 and Flagstaff War in 1845) a continuation of the Musket Wars. The increased use of muskets in intertribal warfare led to changes in the design of pā fortifications, which later benefited Māori when engaged in battles with colonial forces during the New Zealand Wars.

Nauruan Civil War.headline: Državljanska vojna na Nauruju
paragraphs: Državljanska vojna na Nauruju je potekala od leta 1878 do 1888 med privrženci kralja Aweide, ki je tedaj vladal, in tistimi, ki so ga hoteli odstaviti v korist tekmeca za prestol. Pred vojno je na otok in med Nauručane prišlo strelno orožje. Kralju zvesti in uporniki so bili večino vojne na mrtvi točki: eni so obvladovali severni, drugi južni del otoka.

Leta 1888 je posredovalo Nemško cesarstvo: Aweido je vrnilo na prestol in zaseglo orožje bojujočih se strani. Nemški vojaki so do konca zaplenili 791 pušk, skoraj eno na vsakega še živečega odraslega prebivalca otoka. Po zgodovinskih ocenah je imel Nauru leta 1848 približno 1400 prebivalcev, ob koncu vojne pa okoli 900.

source.title: Nauruan Civil War
paragraphs: The Nauruan Civil War was fought from 1878 to 1888, between forces loyal to incumbent King Aweida of Nauru and those seeking to depose him in favour of a rival claimant. The war was preceded by the introduction of firearms to the island and its inhabitants, Nauruans, as a whole. For the majority of the war, the loyalists and the rebels found themselves in a stalemate, with one side controlling the northern and the other the southern part of the island.

In 1888, the German Empire intervened by restoring Aweida to the throne and confiscating combatants' firearms; by the time they finished, the German soldiers had confiscated 791 rifles from both belligerents, nearly one gun for every remaining living adult inhabitant of the island. By historical estimates, Nauru had a population of approximately 1,400 in 1848; by the end of war, there were about 900 inhabitants.

Naval Battle of Guadalcanal.headline: Pomorska bitka pri Guadalcanalu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Guadalcanalu je potekala od 12. do 15. novembra 1942 in je bila odločilni spopad v vrsti pomorskih bitk med zavezniškimi (predvsem ameriškimi) in japonskimi cesarskimi silami v večmesečni guadalcanalski kampanji na Salomonovih otokih med drugo svetovno vojno. Štiri dni so trajali letalski in pomorski spopadi, večinoma blizu Guadalcanala, vsi pa so bili povezani z japonskim poskusom okrepiti kopenske sile na otoku. V tej bitki sta padla edina admirala ameriške vojne mornarice, ki sta v vojni izgubila življenje v spopadu površinskih ladij.

source.title: Naval Battle of Guadalcanal
paragraphs: The Naval Battle of Guadalcanal took place from 12 to 15 November 1942 and was the decisive engagement in a series of naval battles between Allied (primarily American) and Imperial Japanese forces during the months-long Guadalcanal campaign in the Solomon Islands during World War II. The action consisted of combined air and sea engagements over four days, most near Guadalcanal and all related to a Japanese effort to reinforce land forces on the island. The only two U.S. Navy admirals to be killed in a surface engagement in the war were lost in this battle.

New Britain campaign.headline: Kampanja na Novi Britaniji
paragraphs: Kampanja na Novi Britaniji je bila kampanja druge svetovne vojne med zavezniškimi in japonskimi cesarskimi silami. Zavezniki so jo sprožili konec leta 1943 kot del velike ofenzive, katere cilj je bil onesposobiti pomembno japonsko oporišče v Rabaulu, glavnem mestu Nove Britanije; potekala je v dveh fazah od decembra 1943 do konca vojne avgusta 1945.

source.title: New Britain campaign
paragraphs: The New Britain campaign was a World War II campaign fought between Allied and Imperial Japanese forces. The campaign was initiated by the Allies in late 1943 as part of a major offensive which aimed to neutralise the important Japanese base at Rabaul, the capital of New Britain, and was conducted in two phases between December 1943 and the end of the war in August 1945.

New Georgia campaign.headline: Kampanja na Novi Georgii
paragraphs: Kampanja na Novi Georgii je bila vrsta kopenskih in pomorskih bitk med zavezniki in Japonskim cesarstvom na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Bila je del operacije Kolo (Cartwheel), zavezniške strategije v južnem Pacifiku, katere cilj je bil osamiti japonsko oporišče okoli Rabaula. Potekala je na otočju Nova Georgia v osrednjem delu Salomonovih otokov in je sledila zavezniški osvojitvi Russellovih otokov. Glavni boji so potekali na samem otoku Nova Georgia, pomembni spopadi pa so se ves čas kampanje vrstili tudi drugod po otočju.

source.title: New Georgia campaign
paragraphs: The New Georgia campaign was a series of land and naval battles of the Pacific Theater of World War II between Allied forces and the Empire of Japan. It was part of Operation Cartwheel, the Allied strategy in the South Pacific to isolate the Japanese base around Rabaul. The campaign took place in the New Georgia Islands in the central Solomon Islands and followed the Allied capture of the Russell Islands. The main fighting took place on New Georgia itself, although significant actions also took place around the island chain throughout the campaign.

Novi Hebridi so bili kolonialno ime otočja v južnem Tihem oceanu, ki je danes država Vanuatu; ime mu je leta 1774 dal kapitan James Cook po Hebridih na Škotskem. Kondominij Novi Hebridi (francosko: Condominium des Nouvelles-Hébrides) je sledil upravi angleško-francoske skupne pomorske komisije (1887–1889 in 1890–1906) in je trajal od leta 1906 do 1980, ko so Novi Hebridi postali neodvisni kot Republika Vanuatu.

source.title: New Hebrides
paragraphs: New Hebrides, named after the Hebrides in Scotland by Captain James Cook in 1774, was the colonial name for the island group in the South Pacific Ocean that is now Vanuatu. The New Hebrides Condominium (French: Condominium des Nouvelles-Hébrides), which followed the governance of the islands under the Anglo-French Joint Naval Commission (1887–1889 and 1890–1906), lasted from 1906 until 1980, when New Hebrides gained its independence as the Republic of Vanuatu.

New Zealand Wars.headline: Novozelandske vojne
paragraphs: Novozelandske vojne (maorsko: ngā pakanga o Aotearoa) so potekale od leta 1845 do 1872 med novozelandsko kolonialno vlado in njenimi maorskimi zavezniki na eni strani ter Maori in naseljenci, ki so se jim pridružili, na drugi.
Spopadi niso potekali po jasnih etničnih ločnicah: Maori so se bojevali na obeh straneh, nekateri posamezniki evropskega rodu pa so se borili na strani maorskih sil.

Vojne so se začele kot krajevni spopadi zaradi napetosti ob spornih nakupih zemlje, ki so jo evropski naseljenci kupovali od Maorov, od leta 1860 pa so se močno razširile, saj je bila vlada prepričana, da se sooča z enotnim maorskim odporom proti nadaljnji prodaji zemlje in z zavračanjem suverenosti krone.

source.title: New Zealand Wars
paragraphs: The New Zealand Wars (Māori: ngā pakanga o Aotearoa) took place from 1845 to 1872 between the New Zealand colonial government and allied Māori on one side, and Māori and Māori-allied settlers on the other.
The conflicts did not divide neatly along ethnic lines, as Māori fought on both sides and individuals of European origin also fought alongside Māori forces.

Though the wars were initially localised conflicts triggered by tensions over disputed land purchases (by European settlers from Māori), they escalated dramatically from 1860 as the government became convinced it was facing a united Māori resistance to further land sales and a refusal to acknowledge Crown sovereignty.

Operacija Kolo (angleško: Cartwheel, 1943–1944) je bila velika vojaška operacija zaveznikov na pacifiškem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Njen končni cilj je bil onesposobiti veliko japonsko oporišče v Rabaulu. Vodil jo je vrhovni poveljnik zavezniških sil na območju jugozahodnega Pacifika (SWPA) general Douglas MacArthur, čigar sile so napredovale ob severovzhodni obali Nove Gvineje in zasedle bližnje otoke. Ameriške sile z območja južnega Pacifika pod poveljstvom admirala Williama Halseyja so napredovale prek Salomonovih otokov proti Bougainvillu. V operaciji so sodelovale zavezniške sile iz Avstralije, Nizozemske, Nove Zelandije in z različnih pacifiških otokov.
notes: The headline comes from the glossary (Operacija Kolo, a Wikidata label); Slovenian usage often keeps the code name, Operacija Cartwheel.

source.title: Operation Cartwheel
paragraphs: Operation Cartwheel (1943–1944) was a major military operation undertaken by the Allies in the Pacific theatre of World War II. The ultimate goal of Cartwheel was to neutralize the major Japanese base at Rabaul. The operation was directed by the Supreme Allied Commander in the South West Pacific Area (SWPA), General Douglas MacArthur, whose forces had advanced along the northeast coast of New Guinea and occupied nearby islands. US forces from the South Pacific Area, under Admiral William Halsey, advanced through the Solomon Islands toward Bougainville. Allied forces from Australia, the Netherlands, New Zealand, and various Pacific Islands took part in the operation.

Overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom.headline: Strmoglavljenje Kraljestva Havaji
paragraphs: Strmoglavljenje Kraljestva Havaji je bilo državni udar proti kraljici Liliʻuokalani, ki se je zgodil 17. januarja 1893 na otoku Oahu. Vodil ga je honolulujski Odbor za varnost, v katerem je bilo sedem v tujini rojenih stalnih prebivalcev in šest ljudi, rojenih na Havajih. Havajska vojska ni obstajala, zato je zmagoviti odbor prosil ameriškega poslanika Johna L. Stevensa za ameriške marince. Ta je poslal marince in mornarje, da bi zaščitili novo vlado in odvrnili japonsko invazijo. Odbor je ustanovil neodvisno Republiko Havaji (1894), njegov končni cilj pa je bila priključitev otokov Združenim državam, do katere je prišlo leta 1898.

source.title: Overthrow of the Hawaiian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Hawaiian Kingdom was overthrown in a coup d'état against Queen Liliʻuokalani that took place on January 17, 1893, on the island of Oahu. The coup was led by the Committee of Safety, composed of seven foreign-born permanent residents and six Hawaiian-born people in Honolulu. There was no Hawaiian army so the victorious Committee asked American minister John L. Stevens for U.S. Marines. He sent in Marines and sailors to protect the new government, and to ward off a Japanese invasion. The committee established the independent nation of the Republic of Hawaii (1894), but their ultimate goal was the annexation of the islands to the United States, which occurred in 1898.

Republika Havaji (havajsko: Lepupalika o Hawaiʻi) je bila kratkotrajna enopartijska država na Havajih od 4. julija 1894, ko se je končala začasna vlada Havajev, do 12. avgusta 1898, ko so jo Združene države priključile kot nevključeno in neorganizirano ozemlje. Leta 1893 je Odbor za javno varnost strmoglavil kraljico Liliʻuokalani, vladarico Kraljestva Havaji, potem ko je zavrnila bajonetno ustavo iz leta 1887. Odbor je želel, da Združene države Havaje priključijo, vendar je predsednik Grover Cleveland, demokrat in nasprotnik imperializma, to zavrnil. Medtem ko so Havaje pripravljali na priključitev, so napisali novo ustavo.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Republic of Hawaii
paragraphs: The Republic of Hawaii (Hawaiian: Lepupalika o Hawaiʻi, pronounced [lepupəˈlikə o həˈvɐjʔi]) was a short-lived one-party state in Hawaiʻi between July 4, 1894, when the Provisional Government of Hawaii had ended, and August 12, 1898, when it became annexed by the United States as an unincorporated and unorganized territory. In 1893, the Committee of Public Safety overthrew Queen Liliʻuokalani, the monarch of the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi, after she rejected the 1887 Bayonet Constitution. The Committee of Public Safety intended for Hawaii to be annexed by the United States; however, President Grover Cleveland, a Democrat opposed to imperialism, refused. A new constitution was subsequently written while Hawaii was being prepared for annexation.

Rum Rebellion.headline: Rumov upor
paragraphs: Rumov upor leta 1808 je bil državni udar v britanski kazenski koloniji Novi Južni Wales, s katerim je Korpus Novega Južnega Walesa odstavil guvernerja Williama Bligha. Bil je prvi in doslej edini vojaški udar v Avstraliji, ime pa je dobil po nezakoniti trgovini z rumom v zgodnjem Sydneyju, nad katero je imel »Rumov korpus«, kot so ga začeli imenovati, monopol. V prvi polovici 19. stoletja so ga v Avstraliji pogosto imenovali Veliki upor.

source.title: Rum Rebellion
